code:
RED TEAM     Blind. Real-world detection capability.
              Slow feedback — a report, weeks later.

BLUE TEAM     The SOC/detection function, present in
              every mode.

PURPLE TEAM   Deliberately NOT blind. One technique at
              a time, immediate "did it fire?", fix the
              gap before moving on. Fast feedback.
caption: Purple team isn't a third roster of people — it's a mode.

steps.label: Red announces and executes one technique
steps.sub: then tells blue immediately what just happened

steps.label: Blue checks the SIEM in real time
steps.sub: did an alert fire, and how fast?

steps.label: Both sides diagnose any gap together
steps.sub: missing log source, narrow rule, undeployed detection

code:
GIVES UP:
  the blind, true-to-life measurement

GETS:
  gaps fixed in the same session instead of
  waiting for the next red team engagement
  to confirm they're still broken
caption: Mature programs run both — red on a cadence, purple in between.
